title: Airbourne - Too Much, Too Young, Too Fast
source: Ultimate Guitar chord chart (user-supplied PDF, 2007 album RUNNIN' WILD)
notes: Every chord in the chart is a power chord (root + fifth, no third).

Both verses are a single held A5 for their whole length - eight lyric lines each with A5 over every one. This is the sharpest test of the 'ribbon is too detailed' complaint: a verse should be ONE chip, not a stream of them.
Chorus is D5 A5 / G5 D5 A5 / A5 / G5 D5 G5 A5 (with E5 G5 tagged on the last one).
Guitar solo cycles A5 G5 D5.
Outro brings in the only C5 in the song.
